final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_fee_dur FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_dur) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_len), AVG(p.avg_fee_dur), AVG(p.avg_fee_dur - o.overall_avg) FROM per_rating p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_fee_dur > o.overall_avg
